sloka: सो ऽपृच्छदभिवाद्यैनं भरद्वाजं तपोधनम् ।शृणोषि कच्चिद्भगवन् सुभिक्षानामयं पुरे ।कच्चिच्च युक्तो भरतो जीवन्त्यपि च मातरः ।। ६.१२७.२ ।।
transliteration: so 'pṛcchadabhivādyainaṁ bharadvājaṁ tapodhanam ।śṛṇoṣi kaccidbhagavan subhikṣānāmayaṁ pure ।kaccicca yukto bharato jīvantyapi ca mātaraḥ ।। 6.127.2 ।।

translations.english: Rama and Lakshmana having greeted sage Bharadwaja who had asceticism as his wealth, enquired, saying, "Have you heard that crops have been good, Bharata is active, and mothers are doing well in Ayodhya?"
translations.hindi: सब लोगों के सामने पहिले कभी न सुने हुए ऐसे रूखे चचनों झो सुन कर, सीता जा ने लज्जित हो सिर नीचा कर लिआ
